name: TensorRT-LLM on NVIDIA (PyTorch backend)
description: NVIDIA TensorRT-LLM runner using the default PyTorch backend (torch.export + torch.compile). No explicit engine build step — loads models directly from HuggingFace. Compares against the vLLM runner on identical hardware to isolate framework-level (vLLM vs TensorRT-LLM) effects on benchmark results.
notes: Requires tensorrt_llm >= 1.2.0 and PyTorch >= 2.6. The PyTorch backend performs automatic graph capture on first load — the first inference call includes JIT compilation overhead. All benchmarks include warmup runs before measurement to absorb this cost.

suite_support.C: partial — BF16 only; FP8/W8A8/W8A16/W4A16 unsupported in TRT-LLM 0.21 PyTorch backend
suite_support.D: unsupported — torch.export graph capture hangs at 28K context length
